remarks: Bright & Modern Studio with Alcove in Stamford! Welcome to your new home at the quiet, well-managed Hyde Park condominiums. This beautifully renovated condo has an open L-shaped layout with a thoughtfully designed alcove area providing a separate sleeping area that adds to the spacious feel of the unit. You'll also love the abundant natural light. For your convenience, heat and hot water are included, making monthly budgeting a breeze. An assigned garage parking spot is also included and it is easy to get to you car in just a couple of minutes. Onsite gym and laundry rooms on each floor. Located in a desirable neighborhood, walkable to lots of shops and transportation, perfect for anyone seeking a convenient and comfortable living space. Don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity!
